purpose_context: Add a corporate enrichment layer to the pack-governance dashboard that attaches RACI-style accountability metadata (department, SPOC, accountability type, involvement rationale) to each doctrine domain. Data is managed through a new Organisational Bindings dashboard page and persisted to docs/org-bindings.yaml, kept separate from the distributable pack.
purpose_tldr: RACI accountability layer for doctrine domains with dedicated dashboard management page
